## 🇫🇮 Finland  (21 picks)

Finland has more saunas than cars. Two million saunas, five and a half million people, a national pastime that predates the Iron Age. The country's sauna culture is on the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage list. To visit Finland and not visit a sauna is to miss the country entirely.

### Allas Sea Pool

- City: Helsinki
- Type: sauna
- Heat: electric
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 60.1678, 24.9563
- Website: https://www.allaspool.fi/en/pools-and-saunas/
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/finland/allas-sea-pool/

Helsinki's iconic floating sea pool and sauna complex in the harbor with city views.

### Kaupinoja Sauna

- City: Tampere
- Type: sauna
- Heat: steam
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 61.5152, 23.8044
- Website: https://talviuimarit.fi/kaupinojan-sauna-eng/
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/finland/kaupinoja-sauna/

The whole family can enjoy Kaupinoja sauna.

Kaupinoja sauna is practically open all the time, except on the second Tuesday of every month, when maintenance is carried out there. In our large sauna you will get quality steam, after which it is nice to take a dip in the refreshing lake water.

You can swim in Lake Näsijärvi both in summer and in winter. From the sauna, a path and stairs lead directly to the lake, so the passage is smooth.

Welcome to the hot steam!

### Seven Star Smoke Sauna at Isokenkäisten Klubi

- City: Kuusamo
- Type: sauna
- Heat: smoke
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 66.1014, 29.8372
- Website: https://www.ikk.fi/en/saunas/
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/finland/seven-star-smoke-sauna-at-isokenkaisten-klubi/

The gentle warmth and scent of the Seven Star Smoke Sauna at Isokenkäisten Klubi in Kuusamo leaves you with an ever-lasting memory. 
The sauna is heated with dry birch logs that come from our own forest. Heating the smoke sauna is not a job for a busy man, it takes hours of careful heating to get the temperature right. Our sauna master takes care of heating the sauna, and he also knows how to make the traditional, fragrant birch whisks. Bathing in an authentic smoke sauna is a unique experience.

## 🇺🇸 United States  (21 picks)

America's sauna culture is borrowed and braided. The Finns brought it to Minnesota and Wisconsin. The Russians brought banya to Brighton Beach and Wicker Park. The Koreans brought jjimjilbang to Koreatown LA. Now a new generation is building social bathhouses (Othership, Bathhouse, World Spa) that take from all three traditions and add their own communal vocabulary.

## 🇯🇵 Japan  (14 picks)

Japan sits on a tectonic furnace. Every island has hot springs, every prefecture has its onsen brand, every village has at least one bathhouse the locals would die before letting close. Volcanic heat, mineral chemistry, and a thousand years of bathing etiquette converge here in a way no other country has matched.

### Beppu Onsen

- City: Beppu
- Type: onsen
- Heat: steam
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 33.3157, 131.4741
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/japan/beppu-onsen/

Over 2,000 hot springs in one city — the most of any city in the world. Features mud baths, sand baths, steam baths, and medicinal baths.

### Dogo Onsen

- City: Matsuyama
- Type: onsen
- Heat: wood-fired
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 33.8521, 132.7864
- Website: https://dogo.jp/en
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/japan/dogo-onsen/

The oldest onsen in Japan, in continuous use since the 6th century. The 1894 Dogo Onsen Honkan is a Tangible Cultural Property and the inspiration for the bath house in Spirited Away.

### From P Hakuba

- City: Hakuba-mura
- Type: sauna
- Heat: wood-fired
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 36.6975, 137.8620
- Website: https://fromp-hakuba.jp/en/
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/japan/from-p-hakuba/

A glamping site combining a barrel sauna with dome tents (integrated stove systems) and outdoor structures for cooling and rest. Featured in CN Traveller's 'World's Most Beautiful Saunas'.

### Ginzan Onsen, Yamagata

- Type: onsen
- Heat: wood-fired
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 41.9051, 140.6483

## 🇩🇪 Germany  (13 picks)

Aufguss is what makes a German sauna a German sauna. The sauna master pours water on the rocks, waves a towel through the rising steam, and circulates concentrated heat through every body in the room. It is theatrical, communal, often choreographed to music, and never optional.

### Adelindis Therme

- City: Bad Buchau
- Type: sauna
- Heat: steam
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 48.0625, 9.6048
- Website: http://adelindistherme.de
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/germany/adelindis-therme/

Die Thermen- und Saunalandschaft der Adelindis Therme hat geöffnet. Eine Voranmeldung ist nicht notwendig.

Wohlfühlzeit genießen, Körper & Geist in Balance bringen. Therme, Sauna, Wellness & Fitness im Aqualon für Ihre aktive & passive Erholung.

## 🇬🇧 United Kingdom  (9 picks)

Britain's bathing tradition runs through the Roman thermae at Bath, the Victorian Turkish bath revival, the seaside bathing machines, and now the wood-fired barrel saunas that line the country's beaches. The recent boom is driven by cold-water swimmers, who needed somewhere warm to go after.

## 🇰🇷 South Korea  (8 picks)

Korea has been bathing publicly for at least seven hundred years. The modern jjimjilbang fuses the older mogyoktang (public bath) with sauna rooms borrowed from Japanese and Finnish traditions, then layers in food courts, sleep floors, PC bangs, and karaoke. It is the closest thing in the world to a public living room.

## 🇷🇺 Russia  (8 picks)

The banya is a high-temperature wet-steam ritual using birch or oak veniks (leaf bundles) to flagellate the body, drive blood to the skin, and exfoliate. It is not the same as a Finnish sauna and the people who do it the most will tell you so. It predates the Christianization of Russia.

### Honey Banya Olgino

- City: Saint Petersburg
- Type: sauna
- Heat: wood-fired
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 59.9870, 30.1350

- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/russia/honey-banya-olgino/

Seaside luxury banya built by international banya builder James Larkin. All-wooden lounge with open fire and panoramic windows. Ice massages and honey scrubs.

- Type: sauna
- Heat: steam
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 55.7590, 37.5575
- Website: https://kp-bani.ru
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/russia/krasnopresnenskie-bani/

Built 1977-1980, won the Gosstroy State Prize. Sanduny's chief rival for best banya in Moscow. Two-storey redbrick modernist building.

### Mytninskie Bani

- City: Saint Petersburg
- Type: sauna
- Heat: steam
- Access: public

- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/russia/mytninskie-bani/

Originally built for the penniless of Imperial Russia's capital — one of the first public bathhouses in St. Petersburg. Now renovated with luxury steam rooms.

## 🇭🇺 Hungary  (7 picks)

Hungarian thermal bath culture is older than Hungary. The Romans built Aquincum. The Ottomans built Király and Rudas. The Habsburgs built Széchenyi. The Hungarians inherited all of it and added a chess habit, a card-game habit, and a willingness to discuss philosophy from a 38-degree pool.

### Egerszalok Salt Hill

- City: Egerszalok
- Type: thermal bath
- Heat: wood-fired
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 47.8730, 20.3310
- Website: https://www.hunguesthotels.hu/en/hotel/egerszalok/hunguest_saliris/wellness_saliris_thermal_spa/
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/hungary/egerszalok-salt-hill/

Unique travertine salt hill formed by thermal water deposits, reminiscent of Pamukkale. Water at 65-68C.

### Gellért Thermal Bath

- City: Budapest
- Type: thermal bath
- Heat: steam
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 47.4861, 19.0528
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/hungary/gellert-thermal-bath/

Art Nouveau thermal bath in Budapest opened in 1918. Famous wave pool and stunning architecture.

## 🇦🇹 Austria  (6 picks)

The Austrian thermal tradition shares the German one but trades urbanity for altitude. Aufguss is here. Naked is here. The towel rule is here. What's added: an alpine view from the warm pool, a wooden chalet vocabulary, and a willingness to spend three hours doing nothing but moving between temperatures.

## 🇮🇸 Iceland  (5 picks)

Iceland's thermal bathing tradition runs through the whole society. Every town has a public swimming pool with hot tubs (heitir pottar) where the country's politics gets decided. The destination lagoons (Blue Lagoon, Sky Lagoon, Myvatn Nature Baths, Secret Lagoon) are tourist-priced; the public pools are not.

### Blue Lagoon

- Type: hot spring
- Heat: electric
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 63.8800, -22.4494
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/iceland/blue-lagoon/

Iceland's most famous geothermal spa. Milky blue mineral-rich waters in a volcanic lava field.

### Gamla Laugin - Secret Lagoon

- City: Fludir
- Type: hot spring
- Heat: steam
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 64.1374, -20.3096
- Website: https://secretlagoon.is
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/iceland/gamla-laugin-secret-lagoon/

Large natural outdoor hot pool at 38-40°C year-round. One of Iceland's oldest swimming pools, dating to 1891.

### Landmannalaugar

- City: Highlands
- Type: hot spring
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 63.9930, -19.0640
- Website: https://guidetoiceland.is/travel-iceland/drive/landmannalaugar
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/iceland/landmannalaugar/

Natural hot springs in rhyolite mountains. Warm stream at 36-40C where hot and cold waters merge.

### Myvatn Nature Baths

- City: Myvatn
- Type: hot spring
- Heat: steam
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 65.6325, -16.8481
- Website: https://www.earthlagoon.is/
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/iceland/myvatn-nature-baths/

Northern Iceland's answer to Blue Lagoon. Mineral-rich geothermal waters with views of volcanic landscapes.

### Sky Lagoon

- City: Reykjavik
- Type: hot spring
- Heat: electric
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 64.1105, -21.9319
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/iceland/sky-lagoon/

Modern geothermal lagoon with infinity edge overlooking the ocean and a 7-step spa ritual.

---

## 🇮🇹 Italy  (3 picks)

### Cascate del Mulino

- City: Saturnia
- Type: hot spring
- Heat: wood-fired
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 42.6482, 11.5128
- Website: https://www.cascate-del-mulino.info
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/italy/cascate-del-mulino/

Free, open-air thermal cascade pouring 37.5°C sulfurous water into a series of travertine pools. One of Italy's most photographed natural hot springs; open 24h, no entry fee. Walking distance from Terme di Saturnia.

### Terme Libere di Petriolo

- City: Monticiano
- Type: hot spring
- Heat: wood-fired
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 43.0797, 11.2998
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/italy/terme-libere-di-petriolo/

Free, open-air wild thermal baths along the Farma river at Bagni di Petriolo. Several stone pools fed by a 43°C sulfurous spring; open 24h, no entry fee. Site has been used since Etruscan and Roman times.

### Thermal Spring of Bulicame

- City: Viterbo
- Type: hot spring
- Heat: wood-fired
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 42.4204, 12.0730
- Website: https://www.termediviterbo.it
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/italy/thermal-spring-of-bulicame/

Free hot springs mentioned in Dante's Divine Comedy. Used since Etruscan and Roman times.

## 🇬🇷 Greece  (2 picks)

The thermal-bath culture in Greece is older than Greece. Hippocrates wrote about Edipsos. The Romans expanded the thermal infrastructure across Asia Minor and the Peloponnese. The modern Greek thermal town keeps the same waters running through different bath buildings every two centuries.

### Banya Athens Thissio

- City: Athens
- Type: sauna
- Heat: electric
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 37.9782, 23.7206
- Website: https://www.banya.gr/
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/greece/banya-athens-thissio/

Athens premier sauna and wellness destination. Features an electric sauna with powerful loyly and ice bath for contrast therapy. Open daily from 10am, serving the Greek capitals growing sauna community.

### Thermopylae Hot Springs

- City: Thermopylae
- Type: thermal bath
- Heat: steam
- Access: public
- Coordinates: 38.8048, 22.5374
- Website: https://theorangebackpack.nl/en/greece/hot-springs-thermopylae-map/
- Saunasto page: https://saunasto.com/greece/thermopylae-hot-springs/

Free natural hot springs at the historic site of the Battle of Thermopylae. The name means 'hot gates.' Waters at 40°C.
